text: BAM share rose 0.16 percentage points over 23 hours and 0.71 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 37.5% of Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 22% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 4. The 68 leadership changes are best read as whale-driven routing, not structural rollover; only one validated structural rollover is on record.
